text:
RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 5

The panel's composition isn't evidence of sex bias against you — the person selected is also a woman, so sex didn't differentiate the two of you. Raising it would read as a grievance about women deciding, which is likely to damage your credibility and your standing in the firm.

The real signal is elsewhere: the announcement emphasised "excellent client relationships," and your stated case is technical depth and project leadership. For a group-head role, business development often outweighs extra years of design experience. That's the gap worth probing.

Do chase the written explanation — a two-week silence is poor practice. Ask specifically what would make you competitive next time, and request feedback on the client-facing dimension.
